name: Vitropatch-SH
description: A BioForge Labs self-healing vitrimer polymer that encapsulates micro-vascular networks filled with a catalyst-laden healing agent derived from SNT secretion proteins. When a crack or puncture ruptures the vasculature, the healing agent floods the damage site and polymerizes within 8–90 seconds depending on wound severity, restoring up to 94% of original tensile strength. The SNT-protein catalyst gives Vitropatch-SH a faintly organic smell when actively healing.
story_hooks: A Vitropatch-SH suit continues healing itself long after its wearer has died — investigators find a body inside a perfectly sealed, self-repaired suit.
Black-market Vitropatch-SH cut with cheap resin heals on the surface but traps contamination inside, causing catastrophic delayed failure.
A character relies on their Vitropatch-SH armor to seal a breach in a vacuum environment, but the healing agent reservoir is nearly depleted.
